scope: Freeze the explicit Checker or configuration-intent family separately from exact execution coloring and the solution consumer set (I02/I07/I08).

inherited owners for the same source

stateVariables.scenario: Named selection, effective configuration intents, and exact component pins. The model accepts at most one named checker.
stateVariables.pending,seen: Unobserved and observed auto configuration intents. Source membership and dependencies supply no intents.
stateVariables.frozen,family: Authority snapshot vs current family after coloring.
stateVariables.owner,solution: Single source owner, separate checker set for nested or empty solution.
stateVariables.phase: Configuration collection, freeze, execution selection, manifest or component rejection.

initialState: Effective configuration intents in unspecified delivery order; no owner published.
assumptions: One representative source and a fixed sibling for the shared solution. Multiple inferred framework intents permit the Native baseline; reporting the nonblocking warning is tested in the CLI. Explicit-selection conflicts, config parsing and unsupported compiler inputs are outside the model.

safety.ConfigAuthority: Named selection wins; a sole implicit framework determines the family; zero or multiple intents freeze Native.
safety.ExactComponent: Same semantic family is not exact execution identity.
safety.SourceOwner: Admitted source has a primary checker.
safety.SolutionConsumers: Solution collects checkers of member sources only.
safety.LegalCases: The legal examples must not be refused.

liveness: None: no caller or external-process completion guarantee.
fairness: None; terminal stuttering represents quiescence only.

bounds.dimensions: 6 or 9 scenarios, up to two configuration intents.
bounds.pruning: None: no state/action constraints, symmetry or view filtering.

counterexamples: Last-wins makes implicit authority depend on order. A shared solution can consume multiple exact checkers.
empiricalVerification: Run generated-graph.spec.ts (ambiguous and unique config intent, Vue promotion and shared solutions), typecheck.spec.ts (inherited owners) and the default-check workflow warning across cold, warm and forced CLI invocations.
